Online course in Model Averaging taught by David Fletcher

This course provides an up-to-date overview of model averaging, from both the Bayesian and frequentist perspective, including methods that are popular in machine learning, such as bagging and stacking. It is based on the material in David’s 2018 Springer book (https://davidfletcher.consulting/book/) as well as more recent developments, including confidence distributions (the frequentist analogue of posterior distributions). There is emphasis on understanding the theory underlying the methods and on experience using the methods in RStudio.

All lectures and exercises are pre-recorded allowing you to work through the material at your own pace. A discussion board allows you to ask questions and post comments.

Cost: US$200 (+ applicable taxes) for 30 days access

For more information and to register go to: https://davidfletcher.consulting/online-course/
